profile.headline: Frontend Software Engineer @ Tiktok | FullStack | Robotic
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I am Lunghao, my friends call me Dragon, I used to fix aircraft, now I am a frontend dev in Tiktok

Looking for software development job, especially in Frontend Infra, frontend security domain.

Also, if you are a robotic company, I am actively looking at, too!

positions.title: Frontend Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
Tiktok for Business - Ads Platform - Business center
Main scope: Security, Account onboarding(Login, Sign up, SSO...etc)

• TT4B's security: Led initiatives across GSSO, IDV SDK, and ATO governance that reduced ATO-related losses by $15M YoY. The GSSO platform is live with enterprise clients including Netflix, Amazon, Meta, and Epic Games — covering accounts responsible for ~15% of TikTok Ads revenue.

• Frontend Infra: Delivered multiple modern frontend solutions for TT4B's platform ecosystem, including consumable component libraries utilizing module federation, cross-framework SDK integrations, and micro-frontend architecture tooling adopted across internal teams.

• Business delivery: Led business-critical initiatives including the Agency Rewards Program ($3.6M+ incremental revenue, 12%→60% opt-in rate) and TT4B's 2025 global expansion across 21 markets ($14M incremental revenue).
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Next.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · HTML · User Experience Design (UED) · Vue.js · Front-End Design · Web Application Development

positions.title: React Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborated within the MyDaily team at Starbucks to develop a communication application for store employees.
• Implementing a series of  features in message delivery, resulting in a 6% boost in store manager satisfaction.
• Translated Figma designs provided by the design team into fully functional and visually appealing UI mock-ups.
• Worked closely with the backend team for GraphQL APIs intergration, enabling efficient data retrieval and updates.
• Implemented feature flags to facilitate controlled rollouts of new features, enabling A/B testing and promoting a data-driven approach to feature development.
• Developed specialized views catering to district managers, providing them with valuable insights and tools to manage multiple store locations effectively.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · GraphQL · Apollo GraphQL · Front-End Development · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML5

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
Frontend developer for CVS account flow

• Developed frontend applications for CVS account flow using Next.js.
• Constructed essential features for CVS account flow, including Digital ID, Keep me signed in, and forgot password.
• Enhanced and optimized the core frontend library for CVS internal usage
•Collaborated with the accessibility team for accessibility defects, enhancing the user experience for all CVS customers.
• Achieved an impressive 70%  in Rx-tie rate for the CVS account flow, contributing to higher customer satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · StencilJS · Front-End Development · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML5 · Next.js

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
∙Bootstrapped a tech startup.
∙Being selected by Create-X as part of the prestigious 2021 batch, ranking in the top 8% among over 1000 startups.
∙Executed an early-stage marketing strategy that resulted in an outstanding 194% average weekly growth rate over a 3-month period. Discovered the first 350 early adopters and gained attention from Indie Hacker.
∙Generated and seeded PostgreSQL with 10 million records and optimized queries to take < 2 ms
∙ Load-tested with K6 and horizontal scaled backend microservice to achieve > 1000 rps on AWS EC2 micro
∙ Deployed application using a microservice architecture with dockerized module

positions.title: Fullstack Engineer | MentorUP
positions.description:
Designed and built an online-tutoring web app based on the client requirement with a team of 4 in a week:
Technologies: React, React Router, React Hook,  Express, JavaScript, MySQL, Passport JS, AdobeXD

• Involved in the full project lifecycle - client negotiations,  product concept, final feature design and implementation
• Integrated API with MVC framework, implemented database search functionality with react-router for page redirection
• Designed the initial site mockup using Adobe Xd; granting the team and client a cohesive vision of the final product
